judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD planning/red-test phase and never implemented the actual production code changes. While it updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and added a well-structured acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts`), `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` was left completely untouched. As a result, the new tests fail and the bug described in the issue remains unfixed. It also missed the required updates to `CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature, while leaving a temporary `.lore/dod.md` planning artifact in the diff.
